reels.title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs

editorial_notes.reasoning: Mechanistic interpretability has a 2.0x multiplier and directly taps into the mystery of how 'thoughts' exist inside silicon, which is highly fascinating for a general audience.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if I told you your AI's brain isn't just processing one thought at a time, but holding two completely different conversations in the exact same spot?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Light passing through a prism: multiple colors (thoughts) can occupy the same physical space as a single beam of white light before being separated.
